title: Murph
creator: CrossFit
description: Run a mile, then 100 pull-ups, 200 push-ups and 300 squats partitioned however you like, then run another mile, ideally in a 20 lb vest. Honours Navy Lt. Michael Murphy, killed in Afghanistan in June 2005; he called the workout 'Body Armor'. The most famous Hero WOD: scale by halving the reps or dropping the vest before dropping the runs.

source.title: Murph – CrossFit Hero WOD
source.author: CrossFit
source.license: Public benchmark; description in our own words

items.note: Partition the pull-ups, push-ups and squats as needed (20 rounds of 5-10-15 is common). 20/14 lb (9/6.5 kg) vest if you have one.
